contradictions.right: stage2a/V2_STOP_CONDITION.json S9 - 'one control construction cannot serve every arm'; K0_MATCHED 'must be constructed per arm'

could_not_establish: No Stage 2B possession arm is registered (measured: 0 of 41 registry records). The contract is written against arm KINDS and has never been validated against a real arm; the two example records are prefixed EXAMPLE_.

The Stage 2B chronological fold boundaries are not frozen anywhere in the repository. EVIDENCE_PACKET_V2 states only 'chronological, nested by season; a game is NEVER split across folds'. The schema requires chronological_folds to be stated but I could not check it against a frozen definition.

pipeline_id remains ASSERTED, not demonstrated. comparison_gate documents this in REMAINING_GAPS and this node's wrapper does NOT close it: a K0 record can declare the arm's pipeline_id while being produced by different code.

The shape checker is a stdlib SUBSET of JSON Schema 2020-12, not a conformant processor - jsonschema is not installed (measured; pandas, numpy and pyarrow are, pytest is not). It implements exactly the keywords K0_MATCHED_SCHEMA.json uses.
Which construction of game_no_in_season the frozen packet intended (X2). The packet does not say and was not edited; both constructions are reported.
Whether the tier partition belongs in any particular arm's K0. That is per-arm by construction and cannot be answered before the arms exist.
Anything about comparative performance. No challenger performance was inspected; stage2b/SEALED_RESULTS was not read and does not exist on disk.

self_assessment: The node produced its two required outputs plus a working schema, a call-site validator and 41 passing tests. It does NOT mark itself accepted. Two of its central design decisions (per-arm K0, the per-arm tier rule) change the K0 structure relative to a frozen packet and are raised for coordinator adjudication rather than resolved.
